notes.title: The Challenge of Space Mavericks
notes.content:
If you like artillery games that have you working against the clock, Space Mavericks is right for you. This game isn’t like any other game that you’ve ever played before. In fact, it was created specifically to challenge you more than ever.

The Oen System is where your journey starts to explore the Universe. Maybe you can find hidden secrets on planets you encounter. To get an idea of the game, imagine yourself traveling from one planet to another, while it gets harder as you go along.

[h1]Unique planets and systems[/h1]

There are different systems and planets, and each planet has its own series of battles that you have to fight. In order to move to the next one and eventually beat the game, you have to use your skills to create the best spaceship and win the battles.

Choose your Commander and your spaceship, where your crew works together to escape the evil Oen Empire. Once you're free of the Oen, you'll get to explore more planets and systems, you’ll expand while doing so.

And remember, Space Mavericks can get very challenging towards the end, keep moving forward. So the more you play, the more you'll conquer. Download our demo now on Steam, iOS, and Android

notes.title: Space Mavericks: The Art of Drawing
notes.content:
Hi, Mavericks! Today we're going to talk about our art team which is working full time to create different stuff for Space Mavericks. There's a lot of work to be done, and we want to share some of our creative process with you. Our team starts every spaceship by sketching.

It all starts with sketches, defining some functions, knowing the settings, coloring, and then some final touches. Our artists think about the structural layout and how that will line up with the features on the spaceships. You can even see in the sketch that the details are so interesting, how it all is created, and it also has a few specific pieces. And we're not exclusively working on Cruiser 02 – nowadays most of our projects have been about modern spaceships and we're loving it!

Imagine that these ships can stay traveling around space even under the most adverse circumstances, they might look small, but they are as big as countries! Go easy here, you never know when you’ll run across a spaceship, like this one. Unless you're really good at running away and rely on your own skills.

[h1]A lot of work[/h1]

It's not only spaceships that we're working on, but planets too. We have planets and whole systems too – beyond Aon. All of the planets will feature on Space Mavericks' campaign, and each one can change your strategy in the game.

So, what do you think about all these drawings? Tell us in the comments or join our [url=https://discord.gg/NH6mM9kKeM] Discord server [/url] to see more behind our development and art team scenes.
